name: Clean-slate student, cybersecurity track
description: First persona targeting the second real track (cybersecurity), added when that track was built. Proves the engine generalizes to a second track's real data without any track-specific code: nothing passed, industry lean, no language constraint. 7 of the track's 8 modules are English-only in the real DB (only Static Program Analysis is de_en) -- a real difference from software_engineering's more mixed languages, not something this persona needs a language constraint to reveal, just worth noting. Industry lean tags every non-theoretical_cs module 'up' and Static Program Analysis (theoretical_cs) 'down', but produces no visible reorder in any layer here, since every layer already either ties or already has its 'up' modules first -- the mirror of software_engineering's p01, where industry lean did visibly reorder.
